⚠ Value is an estimate, not exact. It is kg × cost/kg from the Yarn Costing app at current fibre prices (Regular Cotton Australia, standard mixes, fixed cost). It is not the selling price or the book value. Lots made earlier at other fibre prices, blends costed with the nearest process (≈) and sample yarn make the real figure different.

Every word must match. 30, 30s or 30/1 finds that count. Blend ratios work in any form: 80:20, 80/20, 80.20, 80-20. Other words match quality, blend, lot, cone tip or remarks.
